entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11409"/><div sID="gen20649" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11409"/><hi type="bold">16. take thine inheritance in thyself--</hi>Formerly thou wast Mine inheritance; but now, full of guilt, thou art no longer Mine, but thine own inheritance to thyself; "in the sight of the heathen," that is, even they shall see that, now that thou hast become a captive, thou art no longer owned as Mine [Vatablus]. entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv11418"/><div sID="gen20666" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv11418"/><hi type="bold">30. the hedge--</hi>the wall (see on <reference osisRef="Ezek.13.5">Eze 13:5</reference>); image for leading the people to repentance.<div eID="gen20666" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen20667" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">the gap--</hi>the breach (<reference osisRef="Ps.106.23">Psa 106:23</reference>); image for interceding between the people and God (<reference osisRef="Gen.20.7">Ge 20:7</reference>; <reference osisRef="Exod.32.11">Ex 32:11</reference>; <reference osisRef="Num.16.48">Nu 16:48</reference>).<div eID="gen20667" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen20668" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">I found none--</hi>(<reference osisRef="Jer.5.1">Jr 5:1</reference>)--not that literally there was not a righteous man in the city. For Jeremiah, Baruch, &c., were still there; but Jeremiah had been forbidden to pray for the people (<reference osisRef="Jer.11.14">Jr 11:14</reference>), as being doomed to wrath. None now, of the godly, knowing the desperate state of the people, and God's purpose as to them, was willing longer to interpose between God's wrath and them. And none "among them," that is, among those just enumerated as guilty of such sins (<reference osisRef="Ezek.22.25-Ezek.22.29">Eze 22:25-29</reference>), was morally able for such an office. <div eID="gen20668" type="x-p"/>
entries.content_plain: 30. the hedge-- the wall (see on Eze 13:5 ); image for leading the people to repentance. the gap-- the breach ( Psa 106:23 ); image for interceding between the people and God ( Ge 20:7 ; Ex 32:11 ; Nu 16:48 ). I found none-- ( Jr 5:1 )--not that literally there was not a righteous man in the city. For Jeremiah, Baruch, &c., were still there; but Jeremiah had been forbidden to pray for the people ( Jr 11:14 ), as being doomed to wrath. None now, of the godly, knowing the desperate state of the people, and God's purpose as to them, was willing longer to interpose between God's wrath and them. And none "among them," that is, among those just enumerated as guilty of such sins ( Eze 22:25-29 ), was morally able for such an office.
